landing.metaDescription: Connect your SoDEX account, get a strategy matched to how you already trade, and run it on mainnet. DRIFT never withdraws or transfers your funds.

hero.body: Connect your SoDEX account by approving two sign requests in your wallet. DRIFT studies how you already trade, suggests a strategy that fits, and runs it on mainnet for you.

how.title: From your history to a running bot in about 5 minutes

connect.title: Connect SoDEX
connect.body: Your wallet shows two sign requests: one lets DRIFT trade for you, one approves the builder fee. No gas, no funds moved, nothing to copy or paste.

import.title: DRIFT studies your history
import.body: As soon as you connect, DRIFT imports your SoDEX trades, fills and funding by itself and shows where your profit really went.

plan.title: Get a strategy plan
plan.body: A rule-based engine matches strategies to your data and your goals, and fills in the parameters. Every suggestion says why.

run.title: Run it, watch it
run.body: Backtest first if you like. Then start on mainnet and follow every decision in the Trading Agent. Pause, edit or stop at any time.

strategies.title: Eight strategies, one way to set them up
strategies.body: Every bot is created on one screen: pick a market, check the parameters, see the checks pass, start.
strategies.backtest: Backtest any setup on SoDEX price history before you start. A backtest is a simulation, not a forecast.

safety.title: DRIFT trades. It never moves your money.
safety.body: Once connected, DRIFT can read your account and place or cancel orders for bots you start. It can never withdraw or transfer, and the product has no feature for it.
safety.seedBody: DRIFT never asks for your seed phrase or private key. Connecting only takes two sign requests in your wallet.
safety.limitsBody: Daily loss, max drawdown and per-trade risk are checked by the risk engine, not just shown in the app.
safety.haltBody: Stop every agent and cancel their open orders from any screen, desktop or phone.
safety.retryBody: If an order’s result is unclear, DRIFT checks with SoDEX before sending anything again.

fees.title: One fee, shown before you sign
fees.label: builder fee
fees.body: Charged by SoDEX, through Builder Codes, on fills of orders DRIFT sends for your bots. Which fills pay it depends on the strategy, and the Create screen shows it before you start. SoDEX trading fees apply as usual.
fees.revoke: Revoke the fee in Settings at any time. Your bots pause right away; open orders stay as they are.
fees.liveBody: Bots run on SoDEX mainnet. A bot shows Running only after SoDEX confirms it, and every pause, edit and stop waits for the same confirmation.

withdraw.q: Can DRIFT withdraw or move my funds?
withdraw.a: No. Once connected, DRIFT can only read your account and place or cancel orders. Withdraw and transfer are blocked, and DRIFT has no feature for them anywhere in the product.

sign.q: What do I approve when I connect?
sign.a: Two sign requests in your SoDEX wallet: one lets DRIFT trade for you without any withdraw or transfer permission, one approves the {fee} builder fee. Neither costs gas or moves funds.

suggest.a: After you connect, DRIFT imports your SoDEX history automatically. A rule-based engine reads it together with the goals you set, matches strategies and parameters, and explains each suggestion. You can clear the parameters and enter your own.

paper.q: Can I try a bot without real money?
paper.a: You can backtest any setup on SoDEX price history. Paper trading is coming soon; today every bot runs live on mainnet.

halt.a: Use Halt all agents on any screen. It stops every agent and cancels their open orders. You can also turn off the builder fee or disconnect SoDEX in Settings.

cta.title: See what your own history suggests
cta.body: Create an account, connect SoDEX, and get a strategy plan. Nothing trades until you press Start.

footer.disclaimer: Automated trading can lose money; DRIFT doesn’t guarantee profit. Past results and backtests don’t predict future results. Not financial advice.

riskDisclosure.title: Risk Disclosure
riskDisclosure.warnTitle: Read this before you start a bot.
riskDisclosure.warnBody: Every DRIFT bot trades real funds on SoDEX mainnet. You can lose part or all of the money a bot uses, and with leverage you can lose it fast. Only use money you can afford to lose.

loss.title: Real money, real losses
loss.body: Digital asset prices move quickly and without warning. An automated bot follows its rules whatever the market does: it keeps buying in a falling market or selling in a rising one if that is what its settings say. DRIFT does not guarantee any profit and does not predict prices.

leverage.title: Leverage and liquidation
leverage.body: Futures Grid, Futures DCA, Funding Arbitrage and perps TWAP use perpetual contracts. With leverage, a small price move against you becomes a large loss. If your margin falls below SoDEX’s maintenance requirement, SoDEX can liquidate your position. A liquidation happens on SoDEX and DRIFT cannot stop or reverse it.

margin.title: Multi-Asset Margin
margin.body: In cross margin, SoDEX counts non-USDC assets as margin at a collateral ratio below 100%, so they are worth less as margin than their full value. Losses are settled in USDC. Your USDC balance can go negative, and an account can be liquidated even without an open position. Isolated margin uses USDC only. The Portfolio page shows how much of your balance counts as margin.

sharedLeverage.title: Shared leverage per market
sharedLeverage.body: On SoDEX, leverage and margin mode are set per account and per market. When a bot sets leverage on a market, it changes it for your whole account, including trades you place yourself. DRIFT blocks the start when that would affect an open position, and asks you to confirm otherwise.

items.grid: Grid: if price leaves your range, the grid has no levels left to trade and you hold what it bought, or the short it opened, at a loss.
items.dca: DCA: safety orders add to a losing position. A long fall uses all safety orders and the loss grows with every one.
items.recurring: Recurring Buy: keeps buying on schedule and never sells, whatever the price.
items.rebalancing: Rebalancing: sells assets that rose and buys ones that fell; in a long trend this can lag simply holding.
items.funding: Funding Arbitrage: funding rates change and can turn negative; the spot and perp legs can drift apart; the perp leg can be liquidated.
items.twap: TWAP: slices still pay the spread and can fill at worse prices than when you started.

backtest.title: Backtests and suggestions
backtest.body: A backtest replays SoDEX price history with modeled fills. It is a simulation, not a forecast, and real fills, fees and slippage differ. Strategy plans and AI parameters come from rule-based software reading your data. They are not advice and can be wrong for future markets.

items.offline: SoDEX, networks or DRIFT can be slow or offline. Bots may miss orders, and open orders stay on SoDEX while that lasts.
items.unknown: When an order’s result is unknown, DRIFT checks with SoDEX before acting again, which can delay the bot.
items.key: If your SoDEX connection expires or stops working, bots pause until you reconnect.
items.bugs: Software can have bugs. Server-enforced risk limits reduce, but do not remove, that risk.

costs.title: Costs
costs.body: Bots that trade often pay SoDEX trading fees and the {fee} DRIFT builder fee on many fills. Perpetual positions pay or receive funding. These costs can turn a small gain into a loss.

items.limits: Set daily loss, max drawdown and per-trade limits in Risk Center. The risk engine pauses bots that reach them.
items.botLimits: Set a max loss and stop price on each bot, and keep leverage low.
items.halt: Use Halt all agents to stop every bot and cancel their open orders at once.
items.revoke: Turn off the builder fee or disconnect SoDEX in Settings to stop DRIFT trading entirely.
